audit.why: 52.87% over 505 games. FAVOURED at 4/10 is defensible — Arise! only reaches 525 against your 850 Avengerang, and Shifting Sands is 22s at rank 1 — though 52.87% is a slimmer edge than 4/10 implies. Rating left, reasoning made concrete instead.

Both layers read Akshan on all seven rows and match packet.levelChart, so there is no full-vs-content disagreement to repair. The individual row reasons were vague or wrong and are rewritten in place.

audit.whatIsWrong: The packet defect is right — not one Azir ability was named — and two claims were outright wrong. spikes[0] says 'his passive shield is thin early': Azir's passive is Shurima's Legacy, summoning the Disc of the Sun from turret ruins; the shield is on Shifting Sands (E). wants.foe[1] says 'Land W shield-wall combos': W is Arise!, a 1.5s soldier summon with no shield and no wall. The single biggest missing interaction is Emperor's Divide creating a wall — Riot's Heroic Swing text says he 'gets knocked off when colliding with champions or terrain', so his ultimate can dismount your swing. Also absent: Shifting Sands halts and readies a fresh soldier when it hits a champion, so his dash into you is a trade tool and not just a reposition.
audit.why: Riot text: P 'summon the Disc of the Sun from the ruins of allied or enemy turrets'; W 'summons a Sand Soldier to attack nearby targets for him... deal magic damage to enemies in a line'; E 'shields himself briefly and dashes to one of his Sand Soldiers... If he hits an enemy champion, he instantly readies a new Sand Soldier and halts his dash'; R 'summons a wall of soldiers which charge forward, knocking back'.
audit.corrected: Ability names and the real mechanics written into whys[0], whys[2], whys[4], whys[5], whys[6], spikes[0..3], breakdown.cooldowns, report[5].t, the do/don't bodies, tradeGood, tradeBad, enemyWin, ahead, breakdown.carry, early, mid, late and wants.foe[1].

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown number appeared anywhere despite the whole page being built on 'wait for Shifting Sands'.
audit.why: Shifting Sands 22/20.5/19/17.5/16, Conquering Sands 14/12/10/8/6, Arise! 1.5s flat, Emperor's Divide 120/105/90, Heroic Swing 18 at rank 1, Comeuppance 100/85/70. The stronger condition than the cooldown is the soldier: with none placed, Shifting Sands has nothing to dash to and simply does not function.
audit.corrected: Numbers and the no-soldier condition written into breakdown.cooldowns, report[5].t, dosFull[0].d, dosFull[2].d, dontsFull[0].d, ahead, breakdown.carry, whys[2], whys[5], early, mid and late.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing warned that Emperor's Divide can end a Heroic Swing.
audit.why: The ultimate leaves a charging wall of soldiers and carries the terrain flag; Riot's own Heroic Swing text says colliding with terrain knocks Akshan off. That turns a swing-in through his ultimate into a dismount in the middle of his team.
audit.corrected: Written into spikes[1], dontsFull[1].d, phases[4].why and mid.
